_comment: SYNTHETIC — hand-built from CONFIRMED field paths, not a live capture.
Built 2026-08-12 while ESPN cookies were unavailable. The shape (key
names, nesting) is transcribed from github.com/cwendt94/espn-api
(league.py + box_score.py + constant.py), the most actively maintained
community client, fetched and read line-by-line the same day. Real
field NAMES and TYPES; fabricated VALUES (team names, records).
Shape hazards this fixture is built to exercise:
- team name split across location+nickname (both present here;
a second team below has NEITHER, to prove the None fallback)
- owners[] as bare GUID strings (ESPN's stable cross-season identity,
living OUTSIDE the record block (at the team level, not nested)
- divisionId present on one team, absent (no key) on another
